partners.mechanism_chain: TRPV4 pathogenic variant (MONDO:0008408) —DISRUPTS→ TRPV4 (HGNC:12190); TRPV4 pathogenic variant (MONDO:0011633) —DISRUPTS→ TRPV4 (HGNC:12190); TRPV4 (HGNC:12190) —DISRUPTS→ Calcium homeostasis maintenance (GO:0006908); Calcium homeostasis maintenance (GO:0006908) —LEADS_TO→ Spinal muscular atrophy (HP:0003197); Calcium homeostasis maintenance (GO:0006908) —LEADS_TO→ Axonal Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease (HP:0004743). Pathogenic variants in TRPV4 disrupt its function in maintaining calcium homeostasis. This disruption leads to a shared downstream effect on cellular processes critical for both motor neuron survival (spasticity) and peripheral nerve integrity (axonal transport), ultimately manifesting as scapuloperoneal spinal muscular atrophy and Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease, respectively.
